comparison.objective: Hang and latch a telescoping server rail at the same rack U on front and rear posts, versus set and lock a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-2073 requires long-part support, peg alignment, telescoping extension, and two-end latching; the candidate requires localized two-tool countertorque and articulated verification.
comparison.success_condition: PR-2073 requires both ends latched at the marked U, levelness, release, and no fall; the candidate requires angle retention through repeated gripper cycles.
comparison.reason: Rack-rail installation tests distributed alignment and latching, not preservation of a threaded adjustment.
